propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status.
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and the completion-verification gate being enabled, but the documentation presents it as unconditional.
The rebar transition --ref flag, which enables closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree, is omitted from AGENTS.md and not connected to the close workflow.

The referencing-commit scan (_referencing_commit_exists) runs git log with no ref argument and accepts commits referencing the ticket or any transitive descendant, but documentation does not explain the subtree matching behavior.
The land-before-close ordering rule is rooted in the Verified +1 policy, not in the precheck mechanism, but documentation incorrectly implies the precheck enforces the ordering.
